sentences.text: FDA first posted the sodium acetate shortage on 2016-02-03 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21, spanning 129 months on the list.
The shortage posting names Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., Hospira, Inc., Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, Milla Pharmaceuticals, and Somerset Therapeutics, LLC as affected companies.
Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited (FEI 3008316085) was inspected on 2015-09-24 and classified VAI, 132 days before the shortage posting.
That same India plant later received an OAI classification on 2019-09-06 and a Warning Letter on 2020-03-25, well after the initial posting.
Corvale East holds 11.4 days of the 20 mL presentation and 16.5 days of the 50 mL presentation; Corvale General holds 22.1 and 19.5 days respectively.
The rule-identified best option is to buy from Amneal Pharmaceuticals Private Limited, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

Q-a29e78.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00409329905', '00641626101', '00641626201', '71357000710')
